invalidation_reason: E-MILES FWHM is 2.51 Angstrom throughout the fitted rest-frame range, broader than the 2.024-2.186 Angstrom MUSE rest-frame sensitivity range, so pPXF clips the negative resolution difference and the nominal E-MILES resolution grid is non-informative.
purpose: Estimate the full four-bin RX J2129 BCG velocity-dispersion covariance and predeclared template, resolution, and spectral-mask sensitivity without changing the selected system, center, annuli, spatial mask, or success thresholds.
blindness_rule: This execution protocol is frozen after the baseline internal-consistency gate but before any bootstrap or sensitivity result is calculated. No gravity residual or lensing mass residual is an input.

spatial_block_bootstrap.resampling: Within each frozen annulus, sample its intersecting anchored 2x2 spatial blocks with replacement, retaining all valid annular spaxels in each selected block. Fit all four resampled annuli for every replicate.

sensitivity_grid.systematic_covariance: For every non-baseline protocol, form the four-bin shift from the frozen E-MILES 2.6-A, 6-sigma baseline. The between-protocol covariance is the arithmetic mean of the outer products of those shift vectors, preserving coherent off-diagonal shifts.

covariance_construction.bootstrap_covariance: Unbiased sample covariance of the 100 four-bin bootstrap dispersion vectors.
covariance_construction.systematic_covariance: Second moment about the frozen baseline of all non-baseline sensitivity shifts.
covariance_construction.formal_errors: Retained in the profile and ledger but not added as a separate diagonal term because the spatial bootstrap resamples spectra carrying the measured pixel noise; adding both would double count the same statistical information.
